routes.reason: Accept. FA.6 plans reduction-theoretic finiteness of cuspidal spaces at fixed level, coefficient models and descent of eigenvalues, and Proposition 3.1 and Lemma 3.2 add noetherian coefficients, compact support and scalar extension to that layer. PAPER-BOCKLE-HARRIS-KHARE-ETAL-19's accepted extraction plans the same proposition at FA.6. The route is frontier-safe: Lemma 3.2 follows from Proposition 3.1 and the semisimple Hecke action, and GS.5 and GS.7 are downstream of FA.6 and not needed. Corrected: cuspidal-finiteness gains Proposition 3.1's compact-support clause, and hecke-algebraicity the rationality of the cuspidal spectrum.

notes:
Accept, after corrections made in place. Read arXiv:2311.15300v1 (SHA-256 7261083b…, the recorded hash) in full, on page images wherever an index, formula or table mattered. The Annals revision (8 October 2025) is still not served, and arXiv has only v1 (both checked 30 September 2026), so everything is scoped to v1.
Library: IsSl2Triple states nonzero-sl2-triple exactly. sl2-integral-spectrum is built in Tau Ceti f790474 (Sl2/Spectrum.lean:147, 305) and is now library. The other planned stages (DWP.0/5/8, GS.5/7, SR.2–4, ES5, ES7:parabolic, FA.6) were reread and plan their items. No library or atlas owner exists for the missing items.
Items: fourteen statements corrected, among them filtration-recognition (semisimple, algebraically closed), pure-wd (a consistent monodromy convention), the local temperedness tests (real Satake parameters), finite-extension-lift (all non-adjoint types), generic-reducibility (dominant ν), weight-array and centralizer-reduction. Notes added to seven items. Two items added: ghs-discrete-series-purity (route 3) and spherical-tempered-generic (route 2).
Source issues: E1–E5 keep the verdicts of REV-ERRATA-PAPER-CIUBOTARU-HARRIS-26, and this review rechecked them at their locators and agrees; E6–E8 confirmed. Nine new ones added: E9 (misprint, Definition 2.6), E10 (gap, the Theorem 4.3 sketch), E11 (error, Corollary 6.32(1), with a G2 counterexample), E12 (gap, the reduction to adjoint G), and misprints E13–E17. E11 was re-derived by hand: coroot values, Kato's criterion, hermitian symmetry and the deformation from t = 0.
Computation: an exact Bala–Carter enumeration reproduces 5, 16, 21, 45 and 70 orbits for G2, F4, E6, E7 and E8 with pairwise distinct adjoint gradings, matching all 91 printed rows of Tables 2–4; the E7-in-E8 Levi merges (A5)′/(A5)″, (3A1)′/(3A1)″ and (A3+A1)′/(A3+A1)″, confirming E6.
Prerequisites: V. Lafforgue (2018) and Gan–Harris–Sawin are in the atlas batch and are removed under §16; Collingwood–McGovern now links the Routledge reprint (doi:10.1201/9780203745809).
Not recorded, as trivial or unverified: the abstract's residue-field restriction, which the acknowledgments say was removed; Frob_w for Frob_v on p. 10; index slips on pp. 17, 18 and 20; 'C' for the curve X on p. 14; and '[Ca]', possibly Carter rather than Cartier, which could not be checked because the AMS page served a challenge.
